# 由 scripts/gen-gitignore-cases.sh 生成，oracle 是 git check-ignore。
# 手改无意义——重新生成即可。格式：group / rules / 每行一个 path=verdict
# git version: 2.54.0

GROUP basename
RULE *.log
CASE 0 a.log ignore
CASE 0 b.log ignore
CASE 0 a/b.log ignore
CASE 0 a/b/c.log ignore
CASE 0 notes.md keep

GROUP anchored_root
RULE /build
CASE 0 build ignore
CASE 1 build ignore
CASE 0 a/build keep
CASE 0 a/build/x.o keep

GROUP anchored_mid
RULE doc/*.md
CASE 0 doc/a.md ignore
CASE 0 doc/sub/a.md keep
CASE 0 other/a.md keep

GROUP dir_only
RULE logs/
CASE 1 logs ignore
CASE 0 logs/a.txt ignore
CASE 1 a/logs ignore
CASE 0 a/logs/b.txt ignore

GROUP dir_only_vs_file
RULE logs/
CASE 0 logs keep

GROUP negation
RULE *.md
RULE !keep.md
CASE 0 a.md ignore
CASE 0 keep.md keep
CASE 0 sub/keep.md keep
CASE 0 sub/a.md ignore

GROUP negation_order
RULE !keep.md
RULE *.md
CASE 0 a.md ignore
CASE 0 keep.md ignore

GROUP double_star_lead
RULE **/tmp
CASE 0 tmp ignore
CASE 0 a/tmp ignore
CASE 0 a/b/tmp ignore
CASE 0 a/tmpx keep

GROUP double_star_trail
RULE build/**
CASE 0 build/a ignore
CASE 0 build/a/b ignore
CASE 1 build keep
CASE 0 other/build/a keep

GROUP double_star_mid
RULE a/**/b
CASE 0 a/b ignore
CASE 0 a/x/b ignore
CASE 0 a/x/y/b ignore
CASE 0 b keep
CASE 0 a/b/c ignore

GROUP question
RULE ?.md
CASE 0 a.md ignore
CASE 0 ab.md keep
CASE 0 sub/a.md ignore

GROUP charclass
RULE [abc].md
CASE 0 a.md ignore
CASE 0 b.md ignore
CASE 0 d.md keep
CASE 0 sub/a.md ignore

GROUP charclass_range
RULE x[0-9].md
CASE 0 x1.md ignore
CASE 0 x9.md ignore
CASE 0 xa.md keep

GROUP charclass_neg
RULE [!a]bc
CASE 0 abc keep
CASE 0 bbc ignore
CASE 0 cbc ignore

GROUP escaped_star
RULE a\\*b
CASE 0 a*b keep
CASE 0 axb keep

GROUP comment
RULE # not a rule
RULE *.tmp
CASE 0 a.tmp ignore
CASE 0 # keep

GROUP trailing_space
RULE *.md   
CASE 0 a.md ignore
CASE 0 b.txt keep

GROUP nested_negate_in_ignored_dir
RULE build/
RULE !build/keep.md
CASE 0 build/keep.md ignore
CASE 0 build/other.md ignore
CASE 1 build ignore

GROUP star_no_cross
RULE a/*/c
CASE 0 a/b/c ignore
CASE 0 a/b/x/c keep

GROUP deep_anchored
RULE /a/b
CASE 0 a/b ignore
CASE 0 a/b/c ignore
CASE 0 x/a/b keep

GROUP both
RULE *.md
RULE !/README.md
CASE 0 README.md keep
CASE 0 sub/README.md ignore
CASE 0 a.md ignore

GROUP reinclude_dir
RULE *
RULE !*/
RULE !*.md
CASE 0 a.md keep
CASE 1 sub keep
CASE 0 sub/b.md keep
CASE 0 a.txt ignore

GROUP double_star_only
RULE **
CASE 0 a ignore
CASE 0 a/b ignore
CASE 1 a ignore

GROUP anchor_vs_basename
RULE a/b
RULE c
CASE 0 a/b ignore
CASE 0 x/a/b keep
CASE 0 c ignore
CASE 0 x/c ignore
CASE 0 a/b/c ignore

GROUP dir_then_negate_file
RULE node_modules/
RULE !node_modules/keep.md
CASE 0 node_modules/keep.md ignore
CASE 1 node_modules ignore

GROUP negate_then_dir
RULE !keep/
RULE build/
CASE 1 keep keep
CASE 1 build ignore
CASE 0 build/x ignore
CASE 0 keep/x keep

GROUP trailing_slash_root
RULE /logs/
CASE 1 logs ignore
CASE 0 logs/a ignore
CASE 1 a/logs keep

GROUP star_dot
RULE *.
CASE 0 a. ignore
CASE 0 a.md keep
CASE 0 ab. ignore

GROUP leading_star_slash
RULE */tmp
CASE 0 a/tmp ignore
CASE 0 tmp keep
CASE 0 a/b/tmp keep

GROUP escaped_bang
RULE \\!important
CASE 0 !important keep
CASE 0 important keep

GROUP middle_double_star_deep
RULE src/**/test
CASE 0 src/test ignore
CASE 0 src/a/test ignore
CASE 0 src/a/b/test ignore
CASE 0 test keep

GROUP class_in_dir
RULE log[0-9]/
CASE 1 log1 ignore
CASE 1 logx keep
CASE 0 log1/a.txt ignore
